caption: The drawing depicts two views of a decorative strap. On the left, the strap is shown angled and somewhat loosely draped, while on the right, there is a close-up of a section of the strap. The strap is mainly brown with a dark blue border and a thin yellow inner line. The brown area is decorated with a floral pattern featuring multicolored flowers in shades of pink, purple, red, and yellow, along with green leaves and stems. The section at each end of the strap is attached to beige leather tabs and buckles, which are depicted in a tan color. The background of the drawing is off-white. The lower right corner contains hand-written text reading "Anne Leon Becky," and some numbers.
title: Silk Embroidered Suspenders
